title.narrative: Strengthening education on diversity, solidarity, and human dignity for children in Lebanon
Stärkung der Bildung zu Vielfalt, Solidarität und Menschenwürde für Kinder im Libanon

description.narrative: Der Libanon befindet sich in einer tiefgreifenden politischen, sozialen und wirtschaftlichen Krise, die ein äußerst herausforderndes Umfeld für Kinder und Jugendliche schafft. Lebanon is in the midst of a profound political, social, and economic crisis, creating an extremely challenging environment for children and young people. Politically, the country remains fragile. Sectarian divisions weaken state structures and are reflected in the education system, making inclusive and context-sensitive measures crucial. Publlic services – especially education – have suffered a massive decline in quality. Children and young people are directly affected.
